webhooks.detail: Webhook subscriptions per connection (Webhooks tab); events like page.content_updated, database/page changes; HTTPS endpoint with verification

evidence.quote: Whenever a page or database changes, Notion sends a secure HTTP POST request to your webhook endpoint.

sandbox.detail: No dedicated sandbox, but Free Notion workspaces can create connections/tokens and use the API; single-member Free workspaces have unlimited blocks.

evidence.quote: Paid workspaces and single-member Free workspaces have unlimited blocks.

rate_limits.summary: Per connection: 600 req/min (Business/Enterprise), 180 req/min (other plans); plus shared per-workspace limit; HTTP 429 + Retry-After

evidence.quote: Business and Enterprise | 600 requests per minute (an average of 10 per second)
Use the [JavaScript SDK](https://github.com/makenotion/notion-sdk-js), curl, or any client that can send HTTPS requests.
